prompt: A gaunt black-robed human cleric kneels over a dying soldier sprawled on cold stone temple floor, lit only by guttering candles. The cleric grips the soldiers chest as a bright arc of crimson blood-light is pulled out of the victims body and streams into the clerics open hand. The greyish, drained but still human victim grimaces in agony, his pale flesh contrasting the priests dark robes. The background is a shadowed stone crypt with a wine-purple gloom.

A hooded human cleric in tattered black-and-crimson robes stands at a stone blood-altar, both hands raised mid-incantation. A vertical column of glowing crimson blood-essence streams upward from a bronze chalice into his outstretched palms. His face is gaunt and rapturous, lit from below by the red glow. The only source of light is the rising crimson blood-light. The background is a dim cathedral sanctum of soot-stained marble pillars.

A gaunt human cleric in a black hooded cassock stands in a dim crypt, pressing his thumb into a small wax-and-iron effigy clutched in one hand. Crimson blood weeps from the effigy and pours down between his fingers, pooling on the stone floor at his feet. His face is pale and pitiless, lit by a single low candle. The background is a shadowed stone shrine wall hung with bone fetishes in wine-purple gloom.

Side profile of a black-robed human cleric facing south-west, one hand outstretched toward a kneeling drained victim on the right whose pale flesh is greyish. A ribbon of glowing crimson blood arcs through the air from the victims chest into the clerics palm, like a stream of liquid red. The cleric is hooded and gaunt, the victim collapsing in agony. The only light is the crimson blood-ribbon. The background is a soot-stained stone chapel interior.

Low worm-eye view looking up at a towering hooded cleric in flowing black-and-crimson robes, arms spread wide, as twin streams of glowing crimson blood spiral up from the dark floor into his hands. His hooded face glows red from below. The streams of liquid crimson blood twist like ribbons. The only source of light is the crimson blood-glow. The background is a vaulted stone temple ceiling lost in shadow above him.

Close-up portrait of a gaunt human cleric in a black hood, his pale face and bared teeth smeared with fresh crimson blood, cupping a double handful of glowing crimson blood that drips between his fingers. His eyes are wide and ecstatic, lit by the red glow of the blood in his hands. The background is a dim soot-stained stone altar room with a faint wine-purple haze.

A hooded human cleric in tattered black-and-crimson robes stands at a stone blood-altar, both hands raised mid-incantation, his gaunt face rapturous. A thick bright column of glowing crimson blood streams upward from a bronze chalice on the altar into his palms, splitting into red rivulets that climb his arms. The only source of light is the rising crimson blood-light, casting red on the soot-stained marble pillars of the dim cathedral sanctum behind him.
